name: web-english-school-project-slide-with-mobile-screen-and-sticker
title: Chocolate slide for an English-language-school site with goal and solution text and a phone with doodle stickers
whatItIs: A dark brown slide with a huge cream 'english language school', Goal and Solution paragraphs with bold lead-ins, a phone showing an orange-cream mobile hero with a photo in a rounded frame, a speech bubble, a crown, pin and eye doodles, a flower outline sticker and a script 'project 3' sticker.
whatItMeans: Warm and playful; doodles echo the site's own style.
techniques: Add doodle stickers around the phone.
Place the script project label over the corner.

vocabulary.definition: Hand-drawn icons overlaid on a mockup.
A script label numbering the project.
A bold opening word of a paragraph.
A recurring dark brown slide layout.
